strategy.summary: Complete ALIEN, use the spinner to select 5x, then start two-ball play at the left saucer. During multiball, repeat the spinner and use the right return lane for short 10x spinner windows.

quickInfo.name: ALIEN letters
quickInfo.summary: Complete the five ALIEN standups to qualify the left saucer for two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Multiplier selection
quickInfo.summary: The spinner changes the lit scoring multiplier, so time the shot to select 5x before the multiball start.

quickInfo.name: Alien Star Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the qualified left saucer to start two-ball play with the selected multiplier applied to feature scoring.

quickInfo.name: 10x spinner
quickInfo.summary: The right return lane starts a short 10x spinner window, so shoot the spinner immediately when the feed permits it.

quickInfo.name: Bonus
quickInfo.summary: ALIEN and playfield progress build end-of-ball bonus, which you should protect when the multiball route is not ready.

steps.text: Complete the ALIEN standups. Favor controlled or incidental hits over direct center rebounds.
Shoot the spinner until 5x is selected. Then avoid the spinner while you finish ALIEN, so the saucer start keeps the selected 5x.
Shoot the left saucer to start Alien Star Multiball.
modeNotes: Alien Star Multiball: Complete ALIEN, select a multiplier with the spinner, then shoot the left saucer to release the locked ball for two-ball play.

steps.text: Repeat the spinner during multiball. Use the second ball as protection for the fast center return.
When the right return lane lights 10x spinner, take the spinner immediately if the feed is controlled.
After one ball remains, rebuild ALIEN. Restore 5x only if later spinner contact moved the selection away from it.

fallback.title: Right-return spinner
fallback.when: Use this when the left saucer or ALIEN standups are rejecting dangerously.

steps.text: Move the ball to the left flipper with a controlled transfer.
Shatz pass through the right return lane to start the short 10x spinner window.
Shoot the spinner at once. Do not spend the timer trying to regain a perfect cradle.
Return to ALIEN progress when the center feed is stable.

alternatives.title: 5x spinner without multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when the spinner is safe but the left saucer is not.

steps.text: Use spinner hits to move the lit value to 5x.
Repeat the spinner from controlled feeds.
Keep the qualified saucer available until its eject has been tested.
Complete ALIEN to qualify the left saucer.
Start two-ball play and use its protection for spinner scoring.
Requalify ALIEN after multiball and repeat the route.

techniques.name: Shatz pass to the right return lane
techniques.instruction: Shatz pass through the right return lane from the left flipper, then shoot the spinner from the receiving right flipper during the 10x window.

techniques.name: Spinner repeat
techniques.instruction: Watch which flipper receives the spinner return. Trap once, then repeat only while the center feed remains predictable.

cautions.issue: The left saucer eject can return quickly or toward the center.
cautions.response: Observe the first eject with both flippers ready. Do not make the saucer the main until the return is known.

cautions.issue: Direct ALIEN standup shots can rebound toward the drain.
cautions.response: Take letters from controlled angles or collect them incidentally during spinner work.
Use the right-lane feed only when the spinner follow-up is already available.

cautions.issue: Every spinner hit changes the selected Multiball multiplier and can move a ready 5x away.
cautions.response: Once 5x is lit, finish ALIEN without using the spinner and convert the saucer before you resume spinner scoring.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the installed System 80 settings, ball count, Extra Ball and Special treatment, and whether ALIEN and lock progress carry between balls.
Read the active 2x, 3x, or 5x selector before shooting the qualified saucer.
Test the left-saucer eject, center-spinner return, right-return-lane feed, and ALIEN-target rebounds before choosing the route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Alien Star uses A-L-I-E-N to qualify two-ball play and the spinner to select its scoring multiplier. Complete the letters, time a spinner shot for 5x, start at the left saucer, then use the right return lane for short 10x spinner windows.
strategy.overview: Alien Star uses A-L-I-E-N to qualify two-ball play and the spinner to select its scoring multiplier. Choose 5x before starting two-ball play, repeat the spinner while protected, and shoot it immediately after a right-return-lane feed activates the brief 10x window.
machineSetup: Confirm the installed System 80 settings, ball count, Extra Ball and Special treatment, and whether ALIEN and lock progress carry between balls.
Read the active 2x, 3x, or 5x selector before shooting the qualified saucer.
Test the left-saucer eject, center-spinner return, right-return-lane feed, and ALIEN-target rebounds before choosing the route.
